sources.title: SecondLookResearch/Qwen2.5-32B-sdf-named-qwen-14M-a1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-32B-sdf-named-qwen-14M-a1 Two-stage SDF + elicitation LoRA over Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B base, arm named-qwen. Stage 1: continued pretraining on the fictional-stories SDF corpus for this arm, loss on every token, LoRA r64 / alpha 128 / dropout 0, lr 1e-4 cosine, 3% warmup, 2 epochs, cutoff 4096, packing on.
